SELECT j.name, h.step_id, h.step_name,
       h.run_status,  -- 0=failed, 1=succeeded, 3=cancelled
       h.message
FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory h
JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobs j ON h.job_id = j.job_id
WHERE j.name = N'Nightly Index Maintenance'
ORDER BY h.run_date DESC, h.run_time DESC;
caption: The message column usually contains the real error, verbatim.
CmdExec/PowerShell steps run as the service account by default.
